clubSettings.leaveNoticeHint: As in your statutes. Members who want to leave see the earliest exit date and the invoices still open; you see both on the request to leave.
clubSettings.pickColor: Pick a colour from the screen
clubSettings.directoryVisible: Member directory visible to all members
clubSettings.publicPage.hint: Name, logo, description, your public events and a “Become a member” button, without signing in. Groups only when “List groups publicly” is on. Members and their data never appear.
clubSettings.publicPage.title: Public club page
clubSettings.publicPage.widgetHint: Your public events on your own website: you find the code under Events › Subscribe to calendar.
clubSettings.retention: Delete former members after a period
clubSettings.retentionHint: Every night Hubra deletes members who left more than this many years ago (data protection, revDSG). Invoices and bookings stay without the name. Off: former members stay until you delete them.
clubSettings.leaveRequiresApprovalHint: On: members ask to leave and you approve it under Members › Applications. Off: members leave at once.
clubSettings.joinRequestsOpenHint: Off: new members join by invite only, and join.hubra.club shows “Invite only”.
clubSettings.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.
clubSettings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG, at most 2 MB. Shown at the top of the app, in the browser tab and under “My clubs”.
clubSettings.logoTooLarge: The logo is larger than 2 MB.
clubSettings.logoWrongType: Please choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG image.
clubSettings.colorsHint: The primary colour is used for buttons, links and the active menu item, the accent colour for the announcement banner and the secondary colour for the stripe under the top bar.
clubSettings.bank.title: Bank & QR bill
clubSettings.bank.hint: Members pay their invoices to this account. With a QR-IBAN every invoice gets a QR reference that the bank import matches payments by.
clubSettings.bank.incomplete: Without IBAN, postal code and city, invoices can't carry a QR bill.
clubSettings.bank.qrIban: QR-IBAN: invoices get a QR reference.
clubSettings.bank.plainIban: Regular IBAN: invoices carry a QR bill without a QR reference.
clubSettings.mfaHint: Those it applies to can open the club only once a passkey or an authenticator app is set up, in their account under Two-factor. Admins means owners and admins, also through a function.
clubSettings.mfaMissing: {{n}} of them have no two-factor sign-in yet and can't open the club until they set it up. Let them know first.
clubSettings.mfaMissingNone: Everyone it applies to has two-factor set up.
